description.title: טיפול בתביעות צד ג'
description.summary: This table outlines the insurer's handling of third-party claims against the insured. It details the insurer's rights to manage claims, legal processes, and settlements.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את אופן הטיפול של המבטח בתביעות צד ג' כנגד המבוטח, בהתאם לפוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי. המבטח רשאי לקחת על עצמו טיפול בכל תביעה או הליך משפטי המוגש כנגד המבוטח, או לנהל אותו בשם המבוטח. המבוטח מחויב לשתף פעולה עם המבטח כדי להבטיח את סמכויות המבטח. הטבלה עוסקת בטיפול בתביעות צד ג', הליכים משפטיים, פשרה, ושיתוף פעולה עם המבטח. סעיפים רלוונטיים כוללים 11.1, 11.2, ו-11.3.

sketch:
11. Handling third party claims
11.1 The insurer may assume handling of any claim or legal process, which are filed or may be filed against the insured, or to conduct same in the name of the insured. In addition, the insurer may file a legal process in the name of the insured which is necessary to defend the insurer 's rights
11.2 The insurer shall have full discretion in the conduct of the proceedings detailed in sub-paragraph 11.1 and in the settlement of any process as aforementioned, including by way of compromise in the insured 's name provided that same does not impose liability on the insured which will not be covered by the insurer, except the agreed compensation in accordance with paragraph 9.3.
11.3 The insured shall cooperate with the insurer in order to guarantee and realize the insurer 's authorities as detailed in this paragraph.
12. Frequent payment
The injured party is entitled to receive frequent payments from the insurer on account of his claim, under the circumstances and conditions set down in paragraph 5 of the Compensation Law and its Regulations.

טבלה: טיפול בתביעות צד ג'
This table outlines the insurer's handling of third-party claims against the insured. It details the insurer's rights to manage claims, legal processes, and settlements.
ממדים: סעיף, תיאור

11. Handling third party claims
11.1 The insurer may assume handling of any claim or legal process, which are filed or may be filed against the insured, or to conduct same in the name of the insured. In addition, the insurer may file a legal process in the name of the insured which is necessary to defend the insurer 's rights
11.2 The insurer shall have full discretion in the conduct of the proceedings detailed in sub-paragraph 11.1 and in the settlement of any process as aforementioned, including by way of compromise in the insured 's name provided that same does not impose liability on the insured which will not be covered by the insurer, except the agreed compensation in accordance with paragraph 9.3.
11.3 The insured shall cooperate with the insurer in order to guarantee and realize the insurer 's authorities as detailed in this paragraph.
12. Frequent payment
The injured party is entitled to receive frequent payments from the insurer on account of his claim, under the circumstances and conditions set down in paragraph 5 of the Compensation Law and its Regulations.
